_comment: The only file you edit. Pick the dataset folder under datasets/, enable the policies you want, set compute. Registry facts per policy (training flags, tier, VRAM, licence class) live in trainer/policies/*.yaml and are maintained with the repo, not here. CLI flags of ./finetune.sh override anything below for one run.

secrets._comment: Name of an AWS Secrets Manager secret holding a Hugging Face token; null = <project>/hf_token. Needed only for gated base weights (pi0 / pi0.5 / pi0_fast PaliGemma tokenizer, GR00T Cosmos-Reason2 processor). finetune.sh prompts for the token (hidden input, validated against the Hub) before the first staging job that needs it and stores it; cdk deploy -c hfTokenPrompt=true stores it at deploy time instead (off by default); only the base-weight staging job reads it, never a training job (network isolation on).

dataset._comment: source=local reads datasets/<name>/ (the hard requirement: a LeRobot v3.0 dataset folder). source=huggingface downloads hf_repo_id@hf_revision into datasets/<name>/ first (the shipped default is a small public SO-101 pick-and-place set, Apache-2.0). source=s3 points at a dataset already staged in your own bucket. Videos taller than downscale_height are downscaled inside the job; null keeps the source resolution.
dataset.name: svla_so101_pickplace

evaluation._comment: heldout='auto' holds out ~10% of episodes, evenly spaced; or give explicit episode ids. stride 1 scores every held-out frame (slow but what the reference numbers used).

compute._comment: One single-GPU instance per training job; bigger multi-GPU boxes do not speed this trainer up. ml.g6e.4xlarge (L40S 48 GB) is the validated default; ml.g5.4xlarge and ml.g4dn.2xlarge work for ACT at 1/2 and 1/6 of the speed. Quotas default to 0 in new accounts — see README 'Quotas'. spot=true uses managed Spot with checkpoint resume. volume_gb null = derived from the dataset size. keep_checkpoints = newest complete checkpoints kept during and after training (0 = all; lerobot never deletes any and a pi0-class checkpoint is about 19 GB).

smoke._comment: Before every training job a 200-step job on the same instance proves the image, dataset and flags (< $1). reuse=true skips it when an identical smoke already passed.

policies._comment: All 16 policy types this asset offers (plus `fastwam_lora`, a second recipe for `fastwam`), each with the public dataset it was validated, trained or smoke-tested on (docs/DATASETS.md), its instance type and licence switches. Flip `enabled` (or pass --policy <name>) to train one; ./finetune.sh --plan shows the plan and cost first. Policies without a `dataset` block use the shared block above. Statuses and licences: docs/POLICIES.md.

act.notes: validated: reproduces the reference numbers on the shared dataset (100k steps, ~$10 on ml.g6e.4xlarge)

diffusion.notes: smoke-tested on the shared dataset (VISUAL is MEAN_STD: needs sane image statistics, which the 4-task set lacks)

vqbet.notes: smoke-tested; trains on one camera (set `camera` to choose, default the first)

tdmpc.notes: RL/reward-labelled data only; smoke-tested on lerobot/xarm_lift_medium (MIT)

multi_task_dit.notes: licence class unknown (CLIP encoder): set accept_licence; smoke-tested on the shared dataset

smolvla.notes: trained 20k steps on the shared dataset (0.376 x hold)

xvla.notes: terms: set accept_licence; trained 30k steps on the shared dataset (0.463 x hold)

pi0.notes: terms + gated PaliGemma tokenizer (Hugging Face token prompt); trained 20k steps (0.372 x hold)

pi05.notes: terms + gated tokenizer; QUANTILES stats completed in-job; trained 20k steps (0.350 x hold)

evo1.notes: licence class unknown (InternVL3): set accept_licence; smoke-tested on the 4-task set

molmoact2.notes: research-only: set accept_licence + approval_ref; 21.8 GB base staged; smoke-tested on the 4-task set

groot.notes: NVIDIA Open Model License: accept_licence + approval_ref, token account must accept nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-2B; smoke-tested on the shared dataset (48 GB sufficed)

lingbot_va.notes: LoRA r16 (5 B params); accept_licence + approval_ref; smoke-tested on the 4-task set, slow (UMT5 prompt encoder on CPU)

pi0_fast.notes: needs an 80 GB GPU (68 GB peak); terms + gated tokenizer; smoke-tested on H100

eo1.notes: needs an 80 GB GPU (74 GB peak); research-only: accept_licence + approval_ref; smoke-tested on H100

fastwam.notes: needs an 80 GB GPU (73 GB peak) and ~230 GB of job volume (31 GB checkpoints, 46 GB staged weights); licence unknown + approval_ref; smoke-tested on H100

fastwam_lora.notes: second recipe for fastwam: LoRA on the video expert, action expert in full training; needs an 80 GB GPU (78.8 GB peak) and ~330 GB of job volume (13 GB checkpoints, 46 GB staged weights, 24 GB merged copy); publishes a 4 GB adapter plus the merged full checkpoint; licence unknown + approval_ref; smoke-tested on H100

image._comment: ECR tag the deploy-time CodeBuild image build pushes. Read by cdk/app.py; training jobs pin the image by digest (SSM /<project>/image_uri), never by tag.

solution._comment: AWS Solution identity — the single source of truth for both reporting mechanisms: the CloudFormation stack Description (deployment counting) and the AWS SDK User-Agent suffix (API usage attribution). Not a per-run knob: bump 'version' when cutting a release and otherwise leave it alone. pipeline/solution.py is the only reader and always reads THIS file, not the --config override, so a per-run config cannot strip the identity. See pipeline/solution.py for the exact formats and README 'Anonymous usage metrics' for what is and is not reported.
solution.name: Fine-tune LeRobot policies on Amazon SageMaker
